weight_rationale.workflow_completion_reward: Primary service utility. It dominates the at-most-12 dense node rewards and separates complete service from partial progress without using method rankings.
weight_rationale.deadline_miss_penalty: One-time SLA penalty at the first observed deadline crossing; it applies to late completion and unfinished service, but never merely because the trainer stops a non-terminal rollout.
weight_rationale.failed_service_attempt_penalty: Penalty per observable current-node service attempt that cannot execute because the required bundle is absent. This is a failed-attempt proxy, not measured interruption duration.
weight_rationale.service_operation_second_weight: Applies only to compute/fallback/model-load/state-restore seconds; transfer time, recomputation, and the modeled failed-service delay are excluded to prevent double charging.
weight_rationale.transfer_gib_weight: Charges transferred model/state/input bytes once in GiB; no action, prepare-call, or migration-log bonus is present.
weight_rationale.recompute_second_weight: Charges prefix recomputation seconds once; an ordinary handoff has no separate penalty.
